sourceTree.algorithm: Sorted relative path + NUL + file SHA-256 + newline

limits: Chrome/Windows only; no cross-browser, mobile or assistive-technology certification.
Real-asset checks use prepared CC0 ferns and the checked-in ground texture, not maximum-size folders or dense scenes.
Material preview uses UV shading under studio lights; it does not reproduce terrain blending/procedural fallbacks or authored environment lighting.
Static glTF meshes only. ZIP/FBX/OBJ conversion, automatic mesh splitting/LOD generation and unconfigured compression decoders remain outside this workflow.
UI lists permit 24 images or 32 models; large batch memory/performance remains unprofiled.
Concurrent walk-placement work is preserved. Its tests contribute to the current unit total but its browser verification is separate.
